title: Defence Line Forward Together (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, defence is a line that moves as one
Fifteen men one wall, never broken
Up together, slide together, work as one

[Verse 1]
Line up flat across the field, ten metres back
Every defender shoulder to shoulder track
When the ball comes in, push up together
Never rush ahead, never lag in any weather

[Pre-Chorus]
The inside man is the post, the channel guard
The outside man drifts to push the runner toward the lard
The touchline is your friend, son, the sideline
Force them outside where the space is fine

[Chorus]
Defence line forward together, son
Fifteen men one wall, the work begun
Up together, slide together, no gap
Force them outside, close the trap

[Verse 2]
Never the only one to rush forward fast
If the line is flat, the gap is your last
Communication, son, talk every play
Numbers and names, dont let them stray

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, defence wins games
Attack scores tries but defence claims
Flat line, hard up, hit and chop
Never let them through, never let them drop

[Chorus]
Defence line forward together, son
Fifteen men one wall, the work begun
Up together, slide together, no gap
Force them outside, close the trap

[Outro]
Flat line, fast forward
Fifteen as one, hard toward
Force outside, sideline friend
Thats my boy, line defend
